_comment: Copy this to config/alerting.json (gitignored) and fill in real values. A webhook URL is itself bearer-token-like -- anyone with it can post -- so it never gets committed.

webhooks._note: ntfy.sh needs zero signup -- pick a private, hard-to-guess topic name, since anyone who knows it can read your alerts
Slack/Discord/Mattermost incoming webhooks all accept this same shape

email._note: remove this whole section if you only want webhook alerts
